reasons.plausibility: Introducing Mn to FeCoNi-based alloys is a known approach to modify magnetic properties by partially inducing antiferromagnetic interactions and domain wall pinning, so the mechanism is generally plausible with only minor open questions about the optimal Mn content.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment (synthesizing and comparing FeCoNiMn vs. FeCoNiPd/Pt under identical conditions) is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if no significant coercivity increase is observed.
reasons.usefulness: This straightforward compositional modification to enhance coercivity in high-entropy FeCoNi-based alloys directly addresses the research question and outlines a specific experimental approach, making it highly relevant to researchers.
